class.name: NNArea3DSearchSpace
class.brief_description: Returns overlapping [Area3D] nodes within an [Area3D] as a search space.
class.description: This node uses an [Area3D] to define the search space. It connects to the [signal Area3D.area_entered] and [signal Area3D.area_exited] signals of [member area3d] to track overlapping [Area3D] nodes in [member intersecting_areas], and returns those [Area3D] nodes as the search space. Physics bodies are not tracked or included.

members.member: The areas intersecting or within the set area. Useful when debugging the search space.
